title: MEPS 2024 first-event payment bands separate payment from later bill and health context

observations.period: 2024; first office, emergency-room, or inpatient event stratified by self/family payment band

denominator.unit: event-family-specific valid first-event people; payment-band denominators in machine record

payment_band_context.value: weighted bill-problem, fair/poor-health, employment, financial-room, and cost-related care-access shares by payment band

observations.method: Retain one first valid dated event per person/event family, join exactly to HC-256 by DUPERSID+PANEL, and calculate weighted context shares by payment band.
observations.uncertainty: Event payment is not a complete bill or household burden; annual follow-up fields may include prior conditions or the event itself; financial-well-being and cost-related care-access fields are round 4/2 context rather than event-specific; the high-payment ER cell has 28 records; no standard errors or causal effect is claimed.
observations.subgroup: Separate office, emergency-room, and inpatient first-event universes.
observations.counterinterpretation: Payment-band gradients can reflect severity, payer mix, age, access, selection, or service composition rather than payment causing the follow-up context.

boundary: This is a bounded payment-to-context comparison. It does not observe the care decision, alternative, household adaptation, remedy, trust, political action, or geopolitical consequence.
